limitations: The separately launched webpage and VS Code acceptance runs used isolated preview profiles; the shared-profile result is the additional browser opened from the VS Code backend.

The live coding checks cover one focused Vue accessibility edit plus a frontend build, and one VS Code-originated smoke-file edit plus xlang3 execution; they do not establish broad coding reliability, a full redesign, release-package acceptance, or hosted CI.
Dynamic MCP/A2A effects and native-owner restart remain unverified in this live acceptance.
